StudioTextField wraps a UIViewRepresentable whose accessible element is the actual StudioNativeTextField: UITextField. Native intrinsic and fitting heights are at least 44 points; representable fitting respects finite proposed width and body-font height, while the outer frame expands in HStack/Form. UIFont body Dynamic Type and optional monospaced digits are explicit. Environment isEnabled configures the native control. Native editable text remains its accessibility value; no extra accessible wrapper or fabricated AX frame is added.

StudioTextField(_ placeholder: String, text: Binding<String>, isFocused: Binding<Bool>, accessibility: StudioTextFieldAccessibility, keyboardType: UIKeyboardType = .default, returnKeyType: UIReturnKeyType = .default, autocapitalizationType: UITextAutocapitalizationType = .none, autocorrectionType: UITextAutocorrectionType = .no, textAlignment: NSTextAlignment = .natural, monospacedDigits: Bool = false, onSubmit: @escaping () -> Void = {}). Accessibility init(label: String, identifier: String, hint: String? = nil). Caller focus uses State Bool; caller visual borders remain external. API sent to root before integration.

Native editing writes only the caller raw text Binding, then reads it back. A rejected oversized replacement is restored in the actual UITextField with prior selection and no second setter call. Accepted edits do not reassign native text. Unchanged model renders preserve caret and in-progress native editing. Explicit external text changes replace the visible text immediately; an already-changed model wins over stale native events. Return publishes any pending text once, invokes the current onSubmit, and leaves focus decisions to the caller.

Root identified that deferring publication of marked text could leave explicit Save/Apply reading a stale draft, and deferring external Clear left composition visible. Corrected before handoff: editingChanged publishes accepted bounded raw marked text without reassigning it; unchanged renders preserve composition; explicit Clear/reset unmarks and replaces immediately. Return remains blocked while marked text is active. Actual UITextField.setMarkedText regression sources cover accepted composition and immediate explicit Clear.

Programmatic focus work is deferred and coalesced on the main queue, reads the latest request, and suppresses native callback echoes. Native focus callbacks write only when the focus Binding differs. Native configuration does not publish text/focus state. A changed accessibility identifier rotates lifecycle identity; invalidate cancels pending focus, disables the native field, drops bindings and ignores stale input/focus/submit callbacks.

Coordinator caught missing direct import LightingCore in the test source using StudioNumericInput. Added the import and repeated syntax parsing. Also made representable fitting handle a nonfinite width probe without constructing an infinite CGSize.

ProjectNameEditor boundedDraft accepts bounded raw input including Keep/Editorial, rejecting only oversized scalar input. Clear sets name empty, clears its error and requests focus. Successful submit sets isSubmitting=true and focused=false before asynchronously awaiting save and dismissing. Naming sheet items each carry a new UUID. The bridge has per-instance tokenized focus work; invalidate rotates the token, cancels queued focus, removes configuration/bindings and disables/resigns before stale callbacks can publish. Ordinary focus callbacks equality-guard writes; programmatic configuration/focus changes suppress callback echoes. No synchronous or self-reenqueuing source loop was found on these paths.

If an external Clear changes the live binding before configure refreshes cached modelText, the next editingChanged event restores the external value and returns without publishing its native text. This is the existing deliberate stale-event priority. A genuinely new first key arriving in that window would also be discarded. The C855 trace does not establish that ordering: approximately 54 seconds separate Clear synthesis and typing, with several intervening UI waits, and the resulting field value is unavailable. This is a concrete source behavior and a conditional data-loss hypothesis, not a demonstrated cause of the Keep failure or authorization for a speculative patch.

Autofocus is scheduled on the next main-queue turn and requires window!=nil; it does not wait for sheet/menu transition completion. If becomeFirstResponder returns false, no retry occurs until another configure or window attachment. That can leave requested focus true while native focus is false, but the logs contain no responder return values, callback trace, or recovered sheet snapshot establishing this occurred. Duplicate followed a Menu action, so transition timing is a focused hypothesis only. The successfully submitted preceding editor explicitly cleared its focus request before dismissal, so the source offers no direct old-editor refocus path in that observed successful-save sequence.

The keyboard-introduction helper checks a real q/Q/1 typing key is hittable, not that projectNameInput remains first responder after Continue; the test taps the name field before that introduction.
